page.title: Make the reasoning visible.
page.description: Role-relevant signals. Clear evidence. Human decisions, always.
page.loadError: The matching policies could not be loaded.

skills.label: Relevant skills
skills.description: Share of the role's required skills listed on the candidate's profile.

experience.label: Relevant experience
experience.description: Meaning of the profile, work history and live CV compared with the job text. Years alone never decide a match.

location.label: Location & work preferences
location.description: A different country or work mode caps the score below Good.

humanReview.label: Require human review
humanReview.description: Always on. AI cannot autonomously select, reject, contact or hire a candidate.

editor.note: Saving the active policy, or making a policy active, recomputes every match score with that version.
editor.savedActive: Version {{version}} saved. Match scores are being recomputed.
editor.activated: “{{name}}” is now the active policy. Match scores are being recomputed.

library.title: Policy library
library.description: Select a policy to review or activate.

guidance.title: Evidence. Not absolutes.
guidance.text: Never use protected characteristics as matching inputs. Show potential gaps alongside strengths, and make every recommendation reviewable.

create.title: Create matching policy
create.intro: Start a named draft with all approved evidence signals enabled. Human review is always required and cannot be disabled.
create.name: Policy name
create.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the roles, market, or review context this policy supports.
create.descriptionHint: Explain when this policy should be used.
create.assistIdle: Add a policy name and description to receive a tailored suggestion.
create.assistDone: Suggestion added to the description. Review and edit it before creating the draft.
create.assistNote: Written by OpenAI. Review and edit the result before creating the draft.
create.created: Draft policy “{{name}}” was created. Review its signals, then make it active.

name.too_short: Policy name must be at least {{min}} characters.
name.too_long: Policy name must be {{max}} characters or fewer.
name.taken: A policy with this name already exists. Choose a different name.

description.required: Describe the roles, market, or review context this policy supports.
description.too_short: Add more detail: at least {{min}} characters.
description.too_long: Keep the description to {{max}} characters or fewer.

oversight.title: Recruiter match-summary oversight
oversight.description: The top candidates of one job by match score. Recruiters see this ranking and the evidence, never the percentage.
oversight.noCandidates: No candidate in this job's market has a match score yet.
oversight.caption: Skills, experience and work preferences. Human review remains required.

evidence.title: Match evidence for {{name}}
evidence.subtitle: Computed from the profile and the job; no AI wrote this.
evidence.years: {{candidate}} years reported · the job asks for {{required}}+

location.notMet: Location or work mode does not fit the job

rightToWork.true: Right to work in the job's country
rightToWork.false: No right to work in the job's country listed

evidence.disclaimer: Based on profile evidence and stated preferences, not a hiring decision. You remain in control.
